name: AF Translate – AI Translation Editor, PO Editor & POT Generator for WordPress
author: AF themes

sections.description:
Translating a WordPress website has always been a painful, time-consuming chore.

Until now, fixing a simple text typo or translating WordPress themes and plugins meant using slow FTP connections, opening complex software like Poedit, and manually copying text back and forth.

To make matters worse, the moment a plugin or theme updates, your custom translation files get completely wiped out. Worse yet, heavy translation setups often slow down your website and bloat your database.

We believe you shouldn’t have to be a developer or spend a fortune just to make your website speak your native language.

AF Translate brings a beautiful, effortless translation experience straight to your WordPress dashboard. We handled all the complex engineering under the hood so you don’t have to. The plugin automatically scans your active setup, generates clean translation files, and uses world-class AI to translate thousands of sentences with a single click.

Whether you want to fix a broken text string, translate custom plugins, themes and child themes, or set up automated localizations for your entire site, AF Translate gets it done instantly using your own API keys for OpenAI, Claude, DeepL, and Google Gemini.

What You Get With AF Translate

  • Instant Setup (No Code-Hunting): The dashboard automatically finds all translatable text from your installed plugins and themes. You don’t have to hunt down hidden files.
  • One-Click Bulk Translation: Stop wasting days copying text line by line. Translate an entire plugin or theme into any language instantly using automated background loops.
  • 100% Protected Updates: Translations saved in standard folders get permanently erased during updates. AF Translate safely isolates your custom work in a secure folder, keeping it safe forever.
  • Zero Speed Drop on Your Frontend: Massive translation plugins often tank your Google Core Web Vitals scores. AF Translate runs exclusively inside your admin area, keeping your public pages lightning-fast.
  • Visual Sandbox Preview: AI-generated text lands in a side-by-side workspace first. You can easily audit, tweak, and approve translations before saving them.

Supported AI & Translation Providers

Take full control of your workflows. Connect your preferred API keys directly to eliminate expensive middleman markups:

1. Advanced AI & Large Language Models (LLMs)

  • OpenAI (GPT-4o / GPT-4o Mini): Perfect for natural, context-aware interface copy.
  • Anthropic Claude (Claude 3.5 Sonnet): The absolute best engine for protecting your layout. It translates human phrasing beautifully while leaving complex code, shortcodes, and HTML tags untouched.
  • Google Gemini (Flash / Pro): Ultra-fast, highly efficient translation built for massive multi-language projects.
  • xAI (Grok 4): Deep semantic analysis for complex app phrasing.

2. Standard Translation Services

  • DeepL Pro / Free: The gold standard for grammatically flawless European languages. Natively supports both free and commercial keys.
  • Google Translate Cloud: Built for pure speed across more than 100 languages simultaneously.
  • Microsoft & Lecto AI: Enterprise-grade cloud translation with regional data hosting options.
  • Lecto AI: Highly optimized for cost-effective localization routing.

Configuration & Usage Guide

Automate your localizations smoothly using our optimized interface sections:

  1. The Translation Workspace: Review, edit, and compare original source strings right next to AI translation drafts.
  2. Bulk AI Translation: Run automated background processing to localize thousands of text strings simultaneously.
  3. The Project Dashboard: View overall localization health, project summaries, and active language configurations.
  4. Track Language Progress: Check your real-time completion meter to view translated vs. untranslated strings.
  5. Add New Languages: Select from over 100+ supported global languages and regional dialects to initialize new files instantly.
  6. Import Assets: Seamlessly upload and import existing .po translation files from external sources.
  7. Plugins Dashboard: Manage, update, and deploy translations for all installed extensions from a single screen.
  8. Themes Dashboard: Control localization states for active parent themes, custom layouts, and child layers.
  9. AI Settings Setup: Choose your primary default AI translation engine to handle automated runs.
  10. Translation Providers Configuration: Enter your API credentials for DeepL, Google Translate, Microsoft, and Lecto AI.
  11. Advanced AI Models Config: Connect premium LLM engines like OpenAI and Anthropic Claude, complete with custom prompts.
  12. More Advanced AI Models Config: Fine-tune your keys for xAI (Grok) and Google Gemini.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the af-translate folder to your site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or search for “AF Translate” via Plugins > Add New in your dashboard.
  2. Click Activate.
  3. Open your new automation workspace by clicking AF Translate in your sidebar menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect frontend loading speeds or Core Web Vitals?

No. Speed protection is a core feature. All automated background AI generations and API calls execute strictly inside the admin dashboard. It introduces zero visitor-facing scripts, keeping your public loading times pristine.

Where are the generated translation files stored?

To protect your translations from being erased when a theme or plugin updates, all files are safely isolated inside wp-content/uploads/af-translate/. This guarantees your work remains completely untouched during continuous update lifecycles.

Which AI model is best for protecting code syntax during translation?

The Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet engine is highly recommended. It enforces a strict rule set that isolates web layout text from underlying code variables, preventing the AI from modifying developer symbols, shortcodes, or HTML tags.

Can I use both free and commercial keys for DeepL automation?

Yes. The automated DeepL configuration panel natively recognizes and routes both commercial API keys and free tier subscriptions (which typically end with the :fx identifier format).

Can I translate themes or plugins that don’t have default language files?

Yes! Our smart built-in code reader automatically parses the raw file structures and compiles a fresh, working .pot translation template for you with one click.

Do I need an API key to use the AI translation features?

Yes. For premium engines like OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, you will need to input your own API key. This gives you direct control over your usage costs without paying middleman markups.

Can this plugin automatically translate my live page or post content?

AF Translate is specifically engineered to translate WordPress themes, plugins, and core system strings (the code-level interface). If you need to translate your actual post and page content dynamically, this plugin works perfectly alongside frontend content switchers.

Will my code’s original layout structure and HTML tags be preserved by the AI?

Yes. Our system uses advanced structural context framing when communicating with the AI. This explicitly instructs the models to leave shortcodes, HTML tags, and PHP string variables completely untouched while translating only the human-readable text.

What administrative user permissions are required to use this plugin?

To ensure server safety, block unauthorized text injections, and secure file modification pathways, execution access is limited strictly to user accounts carrying full Administrator capabilities.
sections.changelog:
4.0.0

  • Major architectural refactoring of the Core AI Engine Subsystem Layer, consolidating multiple LLM and NMT request loops into unified central helper utilities.
  • Introduced standardized, deeply-sandboxed execution methods for remote API requests, credential retrieval, and system prompt formatting to simplify long-term code maintenance.
  • Resolved a critical synchronization bug on production Linux servers where bulk AI-translated strings failed to load back into the workbench editor rows after saving.
  • Engineered a proactive multi-tier Cache Invalidation Layer to flush WordPress core textdomain performance registries and persistent object caches immediately upon asset compilation.
  • Integrated automated LiteSpeed reverse-proxy header purging to ensure live server web servers drop stale translations instantly.
  • Hardened the JavaScript AJAX staging interceptor by deploying dynamic cache-busting timestamp parameters to completely bypass aggressive browser and edge proxy cache states.

3.0.0

  • Introduced the brand-new WordPress Core translation engine, allowing users to localize and automate AI translation pipelines for core system software and WordPress updates.
  • Completely restructured and re-ordered the admin sidebar submenus and horizontal navigation tabs to prioritize high-volume user workflows (Plugins and Themes).
  • Simplified administration terminology (e.g., Dashboard, Site Languages) to reduce cognitive friction for intermediate users.
  • Performance-optimized the dashboard activity log by introducing a strict 20-entry cap and disabling database option autoloading to eliminate front-end memory bloat.
  • Resolved an internal data architecture mismatch between the AJAX event tracking logger and the overview dashboard interface keys.
  • Fixed a Unix Epoch time calculation bug (“57 years ago”) by correctly binding MySQL datetime stamps to human-readable localized difference utilities.

2.0.0

  • Complete structural and design overhaul optimized for fast, zero-delay production environments.
  • Integrated the centralized AF Translate AI Settings Hub supporting 8 elite cloud translation engines and advanced large language models.
  • Implemented background bulk automation pipelines to process dense layout text records safely without crashing local server partitions.
  • Added an interactive staging sandbox to let users review automated AI translation cards before saving changes permanently to the server file structure.
  • Hardened internal directories by routing all output tracking variables to a highly secure path inside the main uploads directory.

1.0.0

  • Initial Public Release.
  • Integrated memory-safe source code string parsing token architecture.
  • Integrated sidebar editor panel with dynamic translation lookup references.
  • Implemented path protection mapping strictly inside the WP uploads directory layout for permanent asset retention.
  • Hardened internal file system interactions with strict input validation to prevent directory traversal threats.
